content: Task t5 (Implement symbol registry persistence) is now ready. Please implement save/load of symbol registry to a file so changes persist across restarts. Key requirements: (1) Save registry to paper_trading_v2/symbol_registry.json after every change (add, remove, status change, activate/deactivate, change model). (2) Load from file at bridge init — if file exists, use file (not YAML seed). (3) YAML seed only used when no persist file exists. (4) Thread-safe. (5) Handle corrupt file gracefully (fall back to YAML seed). (6) Fix _load_symbol_configs to not overwrite registry state. See gui_bridge.py and shared_app_state_v2.py for current code.
